title: The Package
body: You will recieve the package on Tuesday. The driver leaves it at the door if nobody answers the bell.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **receive**. c harfinden sonra ei sırası gelir: re-ce-i-ve.

title: Hard To Believe
body: I cannot beleive the price of tickets this year. Last summer the same seats cost half of this.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **believe**. i ve e yer değiştirmiş: be-lie-ve.

title: Wrong Street
body: The adress on the form is wrong, so the letter went to another street and came back last week.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **address**. Hem d hem s çift yazılır: ad-dress.

title: Exam Dates
body: Write the exam dates in your calender now. The office will not send a second message about them.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **calendar**. Sonu -er değil -ar ile biter.

title: Wet Floor
body: Be carefull on the stairs. The cleaner washed them ten minutes ago and the floor is still wet.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **careful**. -ful eki tek l ile yazılır; sadece zarf hali full değildir.

title: Morning Runs
body: She does excercise before work every morning. Thirty minutes of running is enough to wake her up.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **exercise**. Fazladan bir c eklenmiş; ex-er-cise.

title: The Last Box
body: We finaly carried the last box upstairs at midnight. Nobody wanted to open anything until the morning.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **finally**. final + ly olduğu için iki l yan yana gelir.

title: A Long Podcast
body: The podcast was intresting but too long. I stopped it after an hour and finished it the next day.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **interesting**. Ortadaki e düşmüş: in-ter-est-ing.

title: Quiet Corner
body: The libary closes at six today. The quiet corner upstairs is usually free in the early afternoon.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **library**. İkinci r atlanmış: lib-ra-ry.

title: Not Sure Yet
body: He will probaly come with us, but he has not answered the message since yesterday evening.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **probably**. probable + ly; ortadaki b duyulmasa da yazılır.

title: Table For Four
body: The restarant near the station takes bookings online. We need a table for four people on Saturday.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **restaurant**. Ortada okunmayan bir u vardır: resta-u-rant.

title: A Free Room
body: I tought the room was free, but another group had booked it for the whole afternoon.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **thought**. think fiilinin geçmiş hali th- ile başlar.

title: Same Bus
body: We usualy take the same bus, but today it was full and we waited for the next one.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **usually**. usual + ly olduğu için iki l yan yana gelir.

title: Two Pages
body: Writting two pages every evening is easier than writing ten pages the night before the deadline.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **writing**. write kelimesinin sonundaki e düşer ama t çiftlenmez. Aynı cümlede doğrusu da geçiyor.

title: The First Week
body: The begining of the term is always busy. After the first week the timetable becomes much calmer.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **beginning**. Vurgulu heceden sonra n ikiye çıkar: be-gin-ning.

title: Another Answer
body: Her answer was diffrent from mine, but the teacher accepted both because we explained our reasons.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **different**. Ortadaki e düşmüş: dif-fer-ent.

title: A Short Break
body: We booked a short holliday in October. The flights were cheap because it is not the busy season.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **holiday**. l tek yazılır: ho-li-day.

title: A Small Shop
body: Her bussiness is small but steady. She sells coffee and cakes to the offices around the square.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **business**. s çift, ama busi- kısmında tek s vardır.

title: Two Piles
body: Please seperate the clean towels from the dirty ones before you put anything into the machine.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **separate**. Ortada e değil a vardır: sep-a-rate.

title: Two Families
body: Two familes share the garden behind the building. They cut the grass together on the first Sunday.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **families**. y ile biten kelimede çoğul -ies olur: famil-ies.

title: Strange Weather
body: The weather was wierd yesterday: sun in the morning, heavy rain at noon and snow in the evening.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **weird**. Bu kelime kurala uymaz: e önce, i sonra gelir.

title: Same Seat
body: He allways sits in the same seat at the back. From there he can see the whole classroom.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **always**. Tek l ile yazılır: al-ways.

title: Open Late
body: The computer room stays open untill midnight during exam week, but the printers stop working at ten.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **until**. Tek l ile biter; till ile karıştırılıyor.

title: Nobody Knew
body: Nobody knew the anser to the second question, so the teacher explained it again on the board.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **answer**. Okunmayan bir w vardır: ans-w-er.

title: Hard Choice
body: The desicion was hard because both courses looked useful and they were at exactly the same hour.

question.explain_tr: Doğrusu **decision**. decide kökünden gelir: de-ci-sion.
